Cases
* Test/Validator 1 and 2 are the only cases where the input contains a space character. I think it would be better to start with the cases that don't contain spaces first.

* Only 2 of the 9 visible tests have inputs that don't contain the letter "a". This means there are relatively few cases for players to infer whether the columns of leading spaces should be removed when the first letter used in the alphabet isn't "a". The cases don't necessarily need to be revised, but I wanted to point this out.

Thanks.

- I moved the smaller inputs to the top.
- Hmm, I will think how to fix that and come back to you.
